# Loosecopy

> Paste a blog post or rough notes, get a Twitter/X thread and a LinkedIn post drafted back in seconds. Loosecopy never auto-publishes on your behalf — every draft opens in an editable text box, and a review step is required before you can copy it. You always paste, edit, and publish it yourself.

Loosecopy is a small, independently-run tool. It has no user accounts: pasted text and generated drafts are not stored. The only personal data collected is an email address, and only if someone chooses to join the waitlist.

## Core product

- [Try Loosecopy](https://loosecopy.com/app.html): The generator itself — paste text, get a Twitter thread and LinkedIn post draft back.
- [Homepage / waitlist](https://loosecopy.com/): What the product does and how to get early access.

## Trust & policy

- [What We'll Never Build](https://loosecopy.com/trust.html): The permanent pledge — no auto-publish, no write-access OAuth to any platform, no scheduled posting.
- [Privacy Policy](https://loosecopy.com/privacy-policy.html): What is and isn't collected, who processes it, and how to reach us.
- [Where Your Text Actually Goes](https://loosecopy.com/data-handling.html): A technical, code-level account of what happens to pasted text.
- [Changelog](https://loosecopy.com/changelog.html): Every real, dated change to the product and its policies — including bugs, not just features.
- [Report a Problem](https://loosecopy.com/report-an-issue.html): Bug reports and policy-compliance issues, read by a person.

## Free tools

- [Does This Sound Like AI?](https://loosecopy.com/ai-authenticity-checker.html): Free checker that flags AI-sounding phrasing and patterns in any pasted text.
- [AI Disclosure Line Generator](https://loosecopy.com/ai-disclosure-helper.html): Ready-made phrases for disclosing AI assistance, by platform and tone.
- [Do I Need to Disclose AI Use?](https://loosecopy.com/disclosure-decision-tool.html): A 2-question interactive tool giving a plain-language answer.
- [Fact-Check Your AI Draft in 5 Minutes](https://loosecopy.com/fact-check-ai-draft.html): A fast method for catching invented facts before publishing.
- [Before You Paste](https://loosecopy.com/before-you-paste.html): How to prep input text so the generated draft needs less editing.
- [Make It Sound Like You](https://loosecopy.com/make-it-sound-like-you.html): Six concrete edits for removing generic AI phrasing from a draft.
- [Why Your Twitter Thread and LinkedIn Post Shouldn't Match](https://loosecopy.com/why-platforms-differ.html): Sourced guidance on platform-specific tone and length.
- [Just Got Flagged as AI-Written?](https://loosecopy.com/got-flagged-as-ai.html): A practical guide for responding to a false-positive AI accusation.
- [Pre-Publish Checklist](https://loosecopy.com/pre-publish-checklist.html): A 7-item interactive checklist to run before posting.
- [Link-Placement Checker](https://loosecopy.com/link-placement-checker.html): Flags a link left in the body of a post instead of the first comment.
- [Hashtag Checker](https://loosecopy.com/hashtag-checker.html): Checks hashtag count against commonly recommended ranges and flags duplicates or hard-to-read tags.
- [Passive-Voice Checker](https://loosecopy.com/passive-voice-checker.html): Finds passive constructions in a draft and suggests the active version.
- [Jargon Checker](https://loosecopy.com/jargon-checker.html): Flags corporate jargon and buzzwords that don't translate well for a global audience.
- [Markdown Cleanup Checker](https://loosecopy.com/markdown-cleanup-checker.html): Catches markdown formatting that won't render correctly when pasted into Twitter or LinkedIn.
- [Number & Unit Checker](https://loosecopy.com/number-unit-checker.html): Checks that big numbers and units convert correctly for a global audience.
- [Privacy-Leak Checker](https://loosecopy.com/privacy-leak-checker.html): Flags anything in a draft you might not mean to publish.
- [Readability Score](https://loosecopy.com/readability-score.html): Scores how hard a draft is to read.
- [Reads Like a Translation](https://loosecopy.com/reads-like-a-translation.html): Flags phrasing that reads like a stiff translation rather than natural English.
- [Sounds Generic](https://loosecopy.com/sounds-generic.html): Flags generic phrasing that could describe any product or post.
- [Post Journal](https://loosecopy.com/post-journal.html): A private log, stored in your browser, of what you posted and what happened.
- [Hook Checker](https://loosecopy.com/hook-checker.html): Checks your opening line for cliché openers and length that risks getting cut off.
- [Emoji Checker](https://loosecopy.com/emoji-checker.html): Counts emoji usage and flags the emoji-as-bullet-point pattern.
- [Wall-of-Text Checker](https://loosecopy.com/wall-of-text-checker.html): Flags paragraphs long enough, unbroken, to read as a wall of text.

## Research & reference

- [Why AI Detectors Get It Wrong](https://loosecopy.com/ai-detectors-explained.html): Sourced research on AI-text-detector unreliability.
- [AI Disclosure Rules by Platform](https://loosecopy.com/ai-disclosure-policies.html): What X, LinkedIn, Meta, and Google actually require, with sources.
- [Does Disclosing AI Use Actually Help?](https://loosecopy.com/does-disclosure-help.html): Research on disclosure's real, mixed effect on audience trust.
- [AI Content Glossary](https://loosecopy.com/ai-glossary.html): Plain-language definitions of terms used across the above pages.
